title: 第28章 九妃最高会议
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
迷雾笼罩之地。

    九把王座隐于迷雾之后。

    王座上分别坐着一道倩影，在迷雾遮掩之下不见面容。

    呼！！

    其中一王座上，迷雾吹开，露出了其上一道威严睥睨的火红色身影。

    “明日起，你们便不许再去打扰云江仙了，白天不许，夜晚也不许。”

    迷雾中短暂安静。

    片刻后，传出嬉笑声。

    “龙雀姐姐好大的脾气，难道是凝聚龙运的速度又提前了？你想自己吃独食？”

    “是呀！姐妹们汇聚于大夏的目的便是为了龙运，龙雀姐姐若是想一人独占，那姐妹们怕是不会允许哦～”

    “聒噪！”龙雀不耐烦地喝道。

    “云江仙今日去了云族始祖殿，从其中取了些修炼之物，近期准备跟随本尊修炼，本尊讨厌被打扰！”

    “云江仙…要修炼？”

    “真的假的？他一个纨绔，舍得放弃花天酒地？舍得放弃貌美如花的姐妹们？”

    “嘻嘻，咱们陛下该不会是受了情伤一时想不开了吧，你说对吗？白月光妹妹……”

    “狐狸精！你再敢胡言乱语，本小姐现在就去废了你！”某一王座上传出唐梦宫的呵斥声。

    “嘻嘻，别生气嘛，我就是开个小玩笑~”

    与此同时，后宫某座寝殿。

    外表冰冷的大殿内部，赫然存在着一座小世界。

    此地仙气飘飘、灵气氤氲，灵禽飞舞，宛如小型仙界。

    在这方小仙界的中央，一个穿着白色道袍的绝美女人，盘膝高坐于大道莲花之上。

    她双目紧闭，气息出尘，极具仙风道骨之气。

    然而在她腿上，却躺着一个神色慵懒、目光暧昧的青色宫装女子。

    青色宫装女子同样绝美，周身散发着一股直入灵魂的奇异药香。

    “好姐姐，你听到了吗？龙雀居然不让我们和云江仙接触了。”

    “这好不公平呀～明天本应轮到我去侍奉的，给他准备的大礼，我可是足足炼制了两个多月的时间呢～～”

    青衣女人一边吐槽着，一边往道袍女人的怀里拱了拱。

    甚至，抬手摸上了那张毫无瑕疵的冷艳脸蛋，眉眼间尽是爱慕和柔情……

    “姐姐好美呀～～”
content_en:
A place shrouded in mist.

    The nine thrones are hidden behind the mist.

    Seated on the throne are a pair of beautiful figures, their faces hidden under the mist.

    call! !

    On one of the thrones, the mist blew away, revealing a majestic fiery red figure on it.

    "From tomorrow onwards, you are not allowed to disturb Yunjiang Immortal anymore, not during the day or at night."

    There was a brief silence in the mist.

    After a while, there was laughter.

    "Sister Longque has such a bad temper. Could it be that the speed of condensing dragon luck has been advanced again? Do you want to eat alone?"

    "Yes! The purpose of the sisters gathering in Daxia is for the dragon's luck. If Sister Longque wants to monopolize it for herself, then I'm afraid the sisters won't allow it~"

    "Noisy!" Longque shouted impatiently.

    "Xian Yunjiang went to the Yun Clan's Ancestral Hall today and took some cultivation items from it. He is planning to practice with me in the near future. I hate being disturbed!"

    "Yunjiang Immortal...want to practice?"

    "Really or not? He is a dandy, and he is willing to give up his life and debauchery? He is willing to give up his beautiful sisters?"

    "Hehe, our Majesty is probably emotionally hurt and can't think about it for a while, are you right? Sister Bai Yueguang..."

    "Fox! If you dare to talk nonsense again, I will destroy you now!" Tang Meng Palace's scolding came from a certain throne.

    "Hehe, don't be angry, I was just making a joke~"

    At the same time, there was a certain dormitory in the harem.

    Inside the cold-looking hall, there is a small world.

    This place is filled with fairy air, dense spiritual energy, and flying spiritual birds, just like a small fairyland.

    In the center of this small fairy world, a beautiful woman wearing a white Taoist robe sat cross-legged on the lotus of the avenue.

    Her eyes were closed tightly, her aura was coming out of the dust, and she had an air of immortality.

    However, on her lap, there was a woman in blue palace clothes with a lazy look and ambiguous eyes.

    The woman in blue palace clothes is equally beautiful, and her whole body exudes a strange medicinal fragrance that goes straight into her soul.

    "Good sister, did you hear that? Longque actually stopped us from contacting Yunjiangxian."

    "This is so unfair~ It should be my turn to serve him tomorrow. I have spent more than two months refining the gift I prepared for him~~"

    The woman in Tsing Yi complained while leaning into the arms of the woman in Taoist robes.

    He even raised his hand to touch that flawless and charming face, the brows and eyes were full of love and tenderness...

    “Sister is so beautiful~~”
title_en: Chapter 28 The Supreme Meeting of the Nine Concubines
